scope: Source-derived field candidates only, NOT actual live schema or verified semantic mapping

rows.sourceDefinition: BIGINT NULL COMMENT 'The student_request (type EXTERNAL_OFFER) this was verified from, when there is one.'
JSON NULL COMMENT 'Student V1: {reason, note, windows} from the learner''s reschedule request. Null for interviews rescheduled before this existed, or admin-initiated reschedules.'
DATETIME(6) NULL COMMENT 'The slot this interview was rescheduled FROM, until the student confirms the new one.'
DATETIME(6) NULL COMMENT 'When the slot last changed. Both columns null once the student re-confirms, or if this interview was never rescheduled.'
VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'ON_CAMPUS' COMMENT 'ON_CAMPUS | POOL | OFF_CAMPUS'

VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'PUBLISHED' COMMENT 'REQUEST|SENT_BACK|REJECTED|DRAFT|PUBLISHED|CLOSED|CANCELLED — kept in sync with is_draft/is_active by JobLifecycleService, never written directly elsewhere'
VARCHAR(20) NULL COMMENT 'REGULAR|DREAM|SUPER_DREAM — defaults from CTC, can be overridden with a reason'
INT NULL COMMENT 'Drive owner: TPO admin or a delegated faculty coordinator'
BIGINT NULL COMMENT 'Set when this job is one college''s copy of a multi-college HR drive'
DATETIME NULL COMMENT 'Set once the deadline has passed and the Home "share with company" card was raised'
JSON NULL COMMENT 'What an HR request looked like before it was resubmitted, so the TPO can see what changed'
VARCHAR(500) NULL COMMENT 'Link to the uploaded job description file'
TINYINT(1) NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 COMMENT 'Happened outside the platform
TINYINT(1) NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 COMMENT 'Offers from this drive count as placed (from its job type)'
BIGINT NULL COMMENT 'HR who requested this drive, if any
BIGINT NULL COMMENT 'Which job_round this applicant is currently in
DATETIME NULL COMMENT 'Set when a corrected or imported academic record made an existing applicant ineligible
TEXT NULL COMMENT 'Application-specific assessment link. When null, learner/notification surfaces fall back to job.assessment_url.'
varchar(50) DEFAULT NULL COMMENT 'Null for initial APPLIED'
int DEFAULT NULL COMMENT 'User ID who made the change'
datetime DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
VARCHAR(10) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'OFFER' COMMENT 'LOI | OFFER'
DATETIME NULL COMMENT 'For EXTERNAL_IMPORT acceptances: the 48h window the student can dispute in before the cascade runs'
VARCHAR(36) NULL COMMENT 'Groups every application row this offer''s accept auto-withdrew, so a reversal can undo exactly that set'
VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'TPO' COMMENT 'TPO | RECRUITER'

history.previous: VARCHAR(10) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'TPO' COMMENT 'TPO | HR'

rows.sourceDefinition: DATETIME NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
DATETIME NULL COMMENT 'Set once the holder was told the offer expires within 24 hours'
JSON NULL COMMENT 'Overrides of the college placement rules for this batch; NULL = college rules'
DATETIME NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
INT NULL COMMENT 'Alternative to a date: debarred for the next N drives'
VARCHAR(10) NOT NULL COMMENT 'BATCH | CLASS | LEARNER'
VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL COMMENT 'One bulk action = one id'
VARCHAR(12) NULL COMMENT 'NULL = Not decided at that level'
DATETIME NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
VARCHAR(60) NULL COMMENT 'The college''s own label for this outcome, when one was picked'
VARCHAR(200) NULL COMMENT 'Specifics: the exam (GATE, CAT...), the business, the university'
JSON NULL COMMENT 'Array of {date, label} exam/blocked dates for the season'
BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT TRUE COMMENT 'Several seasons may be open at once; this only drives default filters'
DATETIME NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
VARCHAR(30) NULL COMMENT 'APTITUDE|TECHNICAL|COMMUNICATION|OTHER — feeds readiness, never shown outside the college'
VARCHAR(1000) NULL COMMENT 'Company-private when source = PANELIST; never exported'
DATETIME NULL COMMENT 'Null = still staged, waiting for the TPO (or auto-apply) to apply it'
BIGINT NULL COMMENT 'Set when a later result for the same application+round replaces this one'
